d:
A massive, sentient rock golem with a craggy, uneven texture. Glowing, narrow eyes in a piercing yellow shade. Apparent age of an ancient entity. A hulking, monolithic build. A natural stone exterior in a palette of dark grey and slate. Signature features include a jagged, rocky crest on the head and a heavy, thick stumpy tail made of solid stone. Four thick, rocky claws per hand.
BODY COLOR: slate grey
